exposure: disease activity at beginning of gestation
treatment during gestation (anti-tumor necrosis factor alpha agents, azathioprine, 5-aminosalicylates, steroids)
cohort: A national cohort of 175 Greek women with inflammatory bowel disease (122 Crohn's disease), experiencing 223 pregnancies between 2010 and 2020.
finding: The majority of Greek patients with IBD have a favorable pregnancy outcome, though active inflammation during gestation and a diagnosis of ulcerative colitis are negatively associated with pregnancy outcomes and postpartum flares.
mod_finding: C-sections were performed in 67.1% of cases, but no specific associations with mode of birth were discussed.
